name: sj-svalbard-project-group-payroll
description: Check and calculate a simplified collective salary-tax settlement for foreign research and project groups on Svalbard in 2026. Applies the tax office consent requirement, location outside Longyearbyen, maximum total project duration and exclusion where employees owe Norwegian insurance contributions. Separates the collective settlement from ordinary individual payroll and the historical Barentsburg arrangement. Covers aggregate salary, reporting instructions in the consent, default a-melding fields, feedback, correction and statutory payment timing. Includes a qualifying calculation and an insurance-liability decision case. Use for forenklet fellesoppgjør, foreign research teams and project salary settlements. Identifies the consent application details and case-specific settlement instructions that must be obtained before using the arrangement.
